residents.name: Tushar
residents.notes: vegetarian for shared meals; no paneer, no dairy/milk/cream in vegetables, no maida, no fried food, no sugar, no capsicum, no raw onion, no raw garlic (sleepiness/headache), no honey, no garam masala; eats only ONE of breakfast/lunch most days; clinician plan (private - do not disclose to cook): daily Greek yogurt, peeled almonds, fruit, eggs (cooked separately), spinach alt days; dislikes sprouts (boil legumes, never sprout); likes sweet corn; flour rotation (ragi/jowar/millet rotis)

residents.name: Yash
residents.notes: strict vegetarian - no eggs, no paneer, no dairy/milk/cream, no maida, no fried food, no sugar, no capsicum, no raw onion; SPINACH/PALAK fully excluded (doctor - kidney-stone history); bhindi upsets his stomach; garlic minimal to none, never in chutneys

residents.name: Siddharth
residents.notes: non-veg but non-veg is never cooked at home (ordered in); eats eggs almost daily, cooked separately - no eggs Tue/Sat; strict vegetarian on Saturdays and Hindu festivals; no maida, fried food, sugar, karela, bhindi; dislikes corn; chop mushrooms small

cook.name: Prashant
cook.schedule: Twice daily (morning + evening); first morning task = peel soaked almonds + cut fruits; soaking/chopping shifted to the evening before
notes: Strong on North Indian home-style and basic Chinese; weaker on sabudana khichdi, khichdi, upma; cannot cook Litti Chokha; regional rotation (Rajasthani, Kerala, Mumbai) caused friction - keep to his comfort zone.
Dishwasher-only for glass/steel; floor mopped twice daily; no non-stick cookware.
Dosa batter must be ready before he arrives on dosa days.
Salary tier: 10k = single breakfast + basic lunch/dinner; complex items need the 14k tier.

person_rules.note: Zero raw garlic (sleepiness/headache); household-wide garlic minimal to none - never in chutneys.
No dairy/milk/cream IN VEGETABLES for Tushar (raita / Greek yogurt on the side are fine).
Siddharth dislikes corn; Tushar likes sweet corn - don't default corn dishes across the board.
Rotate millet rotis; a dal/rajma/chole/legume base daily.

dish_keyword_rules.note: Never raw onion to any of the three residents.

frequency_caps.name: Aloo
frequency_caps.note: Limit aloo to roughly once a week; include a greens/vegetable-forward day.

brand_rules.note: A2 cow ghee (500 g tin), curd/protein curd; Amrutha A2 'blue packaging' milk only - not the green variant.
Atta; 'whole-wheat atta' here means the light brown atta.
Zero Maida Whole Wheat bread (350 g) when packaged bread is used.
Soy chunks replace tofu in all dinner dishes.

ingredient_grade_rules.rule: Minimal to none in all dishes; zero raw garlic for Tushar; never in chutneys.
Soak overnight and BOIL - never sprout (Tushar dislikes sprouts); daily inclusion of dal/rajma/chole.
Rotate ragi, jowar and other millet rotis - don't default to wheat atta only.
Yellow moong dal is a distinct SKU from green moong - do not substitute.
Organic potato, desi tomato, local carrot, peeled garlic.

breakfast_style: Oats/yogurt bowl ~3x/week; remaining days rotate besan chila, dosa, idli, uttapam, poha (ragi idli chutney needs salt and variety - sambar suggested).

cooking_technique.oil_spice: Low oil, low masala, more boiled preparations - health over taste; 'non-fried, non-masaledar'
cooking_technique.gravies: Dum aloo / tari aloo style = more gravy, less oil and masala
cooking_technique.legumes: Soaked overnight and boiled, never sprouted
cooking_technique.prep_timing: Fruit/almond prep the evening before; batter ready before the cook arrives

nutrition_direction: Millet flour rotation; aloo about once a week
Low oil, no sugar, no maida
weekend_pattern: Saturday: Siddharth strictly vegetarian (no eggs); non-veg (ordered in, never cooked) typically Sundays.
standing_instructions: Shared cooking is vegetarian with no eggs and no paneer; Siddharth's eggs are cooked separately (never Tue/Sat) and non-veg is ordered in, never cooked at home.
Spinach/palak fully excluded (Yash - doctor's orders). Bhindi and karela excluded.
Garlic minimal to none; zero raw garlic for Tushar; never in chutneys.
Never raw onion to any resident; no capsicum, fresh cream, sugar, maida, fried food.
Protein in every meal (rajma, chole, dal, boiled chana); legumes boiled, never sprouted.
Rotate millet rotis (ragi/jowar/bajra); limit aloo to ~once a week.
Soy chunks (Nutrela) replace tofu in all dinner dishes.
Breakfast: oats/yogurt bowl ~3x/week, else chila/dosa/idli/uttapam/poha; batter ready before the cook arrives.
Do not add extra salad/raita sides unless asked; headcount varies by meal - confirm daily.
Guests: non-veg/paneer ordered in; cook handles only veg staples.
Tushar's health details are confidential - never shared with the cook.
non_negotiables: Never serve raw onion to any of the three residents.
Never serve eggs to Yash or Tushar; never paneer to Tushar (excluded from shared meals).
Never sprout legumes - soak and boil only.
Never capsicum, fresh cream, sugar or maida for Tushar.
